ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Власть» (vlast', 'power') is kept as 'power' throughout, and the closing thought's «правда» / «неправда» (pravda / nepravda) are 'right' / 'wrong', as the context of laws requires. «Феодор Страхов» (Feodor Strakhov) is the same F. A. Strakhov given elsewhere as Fyodor Strakhov; «Иатс» (Iats), unidentified, is transliterated as printed. Amiel's «сознание» (soznanie, 'consciousness') and his «девять праведников» (devyat' pravednikov, 'nine righteous men') are kept as printed, though Genesis 18:32 has ten.
Source observation: [4] «Девять праведников могли спасти Содом» ('nine righteous men could have saved Sodom'): Genesis 18:32 has ten; translated as printed.
